name: Natural Assault
body:
School evocation; Level sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S, M (a drop of blood)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target One creature
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The target gains 10 ft. reach with its natural attacks and unarmed strikes, but only when actively taking an attack action or full-attack action. This does not apply to attacks of opportunity.
